name: Marissa Keaton
career: Custom knife craftsperson and outdoor gear designer
bio: Marissa spends her mornings in her workshop, shaping and polishing knives that are as functional as they are beautiful. On weekends, she and her partner head out to the lake for fishing trips, often joined by friends from her local outdoors club. She has a soft spot for Gypsy Vanner horses and occasionally helps with riding lessons at a nearby stable. In the evenings, she unwinds with retro NES games and sometimes binge-watches Outlander with a glass of hand-brewed kombucha. Despite her rugged hobbies, Marissa has an eye for cozy home décor and enjoys hosting dinner parties that feature her experiments with traditional Filipino recipes.
